title: Kyle Westaway (Harvard Law / Cornell Law startup lawyer) — 'my favorite book of the year already'
summary: Kyle Westaway — startup lawyer, author of Profit and Purpose, and former Harvard Law and Cornell Law lecturer on this exact subject — releases a 40-minute interview with Eric on Incorruptible. Walks the gravity metaphor, shareholder primacy's short history, Whole Foods vs. Costco, the governance fortress that lets Costco tell Wall Street to buzz off, and Anthropic's public benefit corporation and long-term benefit trust.
blockquote: Who is the market, and why is it in this meeting?
blockquote_source: Eric Ries on Kyle Westaway's channel
